summary: vdd-execution-plan governs complete execution-plan create/repair only; standalone requirements files route to direct implementation; choose standard/resumable/self-hosted before model routing; ordinary profiles use Sol/high, Sol/max only for typed recovery trigger with capability evidence; lifecycle draft→plan-ready→implementation-authorized→implementation-complete→acceptance-passed→archived; VDD does not own RED execution; slices require behavior, failure intent, acceptance target, dependents, recovery; repairs are in-place under repair/round-n, preserve history, use lineageFamilyId and max three rounds; mandatory authority, knowledge preflight, and skill-input consumption gates precede plan-ready; clarify only material boundaries, zero questions allowed; bind Git baseline, scoped manifests, hashes, contracts, consumers, tests, and receipts; resumable/self-hosted require append-only 95 report/index; review is optional, minimal-complete-closure required when enabled; P2-only findings do not reopen semantic rounds; composition and callsite completeness checks required for repairs; terminal full validation required before implementation-complete; no multi-writer or adversarial controls by default
